name: Build Farms & Roads
hint: It costs gold now. You get more food later.
ko: 지금 금고를 쓰고, 다음 2년 동안 생산이 늘어요.

name: Raise Taxes
hint: You get gold. People are less happy.
ko: 금고가 늘지만 행복이 줄어요.

name: Cut Taxes
hint: People are happy. You have less gold.
ko: 행복이 늘지만 금고가 줄어요.

name: Open Trade
hint: You get more goods. Other lands matter more.
ko: 물건이 늘고, 다른 나라의 영향을 더 받아요.

name: Close Borders
hint: No goods come in. Things cost more.
ko: 수입이 끊겨 물건이 줄고 값이 올라요.

name: Go to War
hint: War costs a lot. You may win gold.
ko: 큰 비용이 들고, 이기면 금·은을 얻어요 (확률).

name: Borrow Money
text: Borrow money. Pay it back later.
hint: You get gold now. You pay back more later.
ko: 지금 금고가 늘지만 매년 이자를 내요.

name: Make a Little Money
hint: There is a little more money. Prices may go up a bit.
ko: 통화량이 조금 늘어요.

name: Make Lots of Money
text: Make lots and lots of money!
hint: You get gold fast. Prices may go up a lot!
ko: 통화량이 크게 늘어요. 금고도 늘지만 물가가 위험해요.

name: Take Money Back
hint: There is less money. Prices may go down.
ko: 통화량이 줄어요.

name: Raise Interest
hint: People borrow less. There is less money and fewer jobs.
ko: 금리를 올려요. 돈과 일자리가 줄어요.

name: Lower Interest
hint: People borrow more. There is more money and more jobs.
ko: 금리를 내려요. 돈과 일자리가 늘어요.

name: Keep It Steady
hint: Nothing changes. People like a calm bank.
ko: 변화 없음. 예측 가능해서 신뢰가 조금 올라요.

name: Back It with Gold
text: Keep gold to back the money.
hint: People trust you more. You cannot make much money.
ko: 보유고로 돈을 보증해요. 신뢰가 오르고 통화량 증가가 제한돼요.

name: Less Silver in Coins
text: Put less silver in each coin.
hint: You get more coins and gold. People may find out!
ko: 동전 수와 금고가 늘지만 2년 뒤 발각되면 신뢰가 크게 떨어져요.

name: Treasure Ships
text: Bring silver home on big ships.
hint: You get lots of silver. Goods stay the same.
ko: 금·은과 통화량이 늘지만 생산은 그대로라 물가가 급등해요.

name: Paper Only!
text: No more coins. Use paper only!
hint: Paper is free to make. It is easy to make too much.
ko: 지폐만 쓰게 해요. 인쇄가 쉬워져 남발 위험이 커져요.

name: Pay Taxes in Silver
hint: You get more gold each year. You need silver more.
ko: 금고가 안정되지만 은이 끊기면 디플레이션 위험이 2배예요.

name: Big 100-Coin
hint: You get gold fast. People do not trust it.
ko: 당백전. 통화량·금고가 늘지만 신뢰가 떨어지고 물가가 급등해요.

name: Make More Sangpyeong Coins
hint: There are more coins. Shops can sell again.
ko: 상평통보를 더 만들어 전황(동전 부족)을 풀어요.

name: Leave the Gold Standard
text: Money is not tied to gold now.
hint: You can make more money. People must trust you.
ko: 금본위를 떠나요. 통화량이 자유로워지지만 신뢰는 정책에 달려요.

name: Buy Bitcoin
hint: It can go up a lot. It can go down a lot.
ko: 금고로 비트코인을 사요. 가치가 매년 크게 흔들려요. 두 번째에는 팔아요.
